narrationScripts.intro: The lantern tree has gone dark! Follow the path. Help three forest friends bring back its light.
narrationScripts.picnic: Help pack the sound basket. Listen to the sound. Tap a picture that starts with it.
narrationScripts.brook: The bridge is missing its stones. Listen to the word. Tap the missing first letter.
narrationScripts.lanterns: The lantern flowers are sleeping. Listen to the word. Tap the sound seeds in order.
narrationScripts.finish: You did it! The lantern tree is glowing again. You helped every friend. Let's explore!
narrationScripts.picnic-complete: The sound basket is full! Follow the path to the brook.
narrationScripts.brook-complete: The bridge is ready! Cross over to the lantern flowers.
narrationScripts.lanterns-complete: All six flowers are glowing! Follow the lights back to the lantern tree.
narrationScripts.listen-sound: Listen to the sound. Tap a picture that starts with it.
narrationScripts.first-letter: Listen to the word. Tap its missing first letter.
narrationScripts.build-word: Listen to the word. Tap the sounds in order.
narrationScripts.different-sound: That one starts with a different sound. Listen again.

verification.content: 18 unique pictured targets, 3 missions x 6 rounds; every onset item has exactly one valid choice, all bridge/garden targets are CVC, all speech paths and file hashes verified

lifecycle.method: Injected Web Audio/fetch lifecycle exercise using Node assertions; source duration kept finite; did not exercise physical device
checks: stale completion cannot end a newer run
mute interrupts active sound and prevents new sound
cancellation settles while fetch is pending

verification.cleanup: Removed the copied phoneme-k.mp3 after verifying every authored sound, choice and feedback uses c for /k/. It is recoverable byte-for-byte from public/audio/phonemes/k.mp3. No scratch files, failed speech outputs, API tokens, intermediate WAVs or caches remain in the demo.
